about: Every object in the shared database that prisma/schema.prisma cannot declare: CHECK constraints, partial and expression indexes, triggers, functions and sequences, with the definition PostgreSQL prints. scripts/verify-sql-replay.sh (CI) fails when a script adds, changes or drops one without this file. How to add one and how to compare with production: docs/data-model.md, SQL-only objects.

objects.name: Client_merge_metadata_check
objects.definition: CHECK (((("mergedIntoClientId" IS NULL) AND ("mergedAt" IS NULL) AND ("mergedByUserId" IS NULL)) OR (("mergedIntoClientId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("mergedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("mergedIntoClientId" <> id) AND ("parentClientId" IS NULL))))

objects.name: ClientEvent_expense_check
objects.definition: CHECK (((("expenseAmount" IS NULL) AND ("expenseCurrency" IS NULL)) OR (("expenseAmount" IS NOT NULL) AND ("expenseAmount" >= (0)::numeric) AND ("expenseCurrency" IS NOT NULL) AND ("expenseCurrency" = ANY (ARRAY['EUR'::text, 'GBP'::text, 'USD'::text, 'CZK'::text])))))

objects.name: Deal_xero_routing_check
objects.definition: CHECK (((("xeroRoutingMode" = ANY (ARRAY['FOLLOW_CLIENT'::"DealXeroRoutingMode", 'UNMATCHED'::"DealXeroRoutingMode"])) AND ("xeroRoutingContactId" IS NULL) AND ("xeroRoutingConnectionKey" IS NULL)) OR (("xeroRoutingMode" = 'FIXED'::"DealXeroRoutingMode") AND ("xeroRoutingContactId" IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim("xeroRoutingContactId") <> ''::text) AND ("xeroRoutingConnectionKey" IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim("xeroRoutingConnectionKey") <> ''::text))))

objects.name: DealLabel_requiresApproval_check
objects.definition: CHECK (((NOT "requiresApproval") OR ((kind = 'STANDARD'::"DealLabelKind") AND ("normalizedName" <> 'oa invoice'::text) AND ("hubspotCampaignId" IS NULL))))

objects.name: InventoryAllocation_hold_expiry_v2_check
objects.definition: CHECK (((((kind)::text = ANY (ARRAY['QUOTE_HOLD'::text, 'DEAL_HOLD'::text])) AND ("expiresAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("expiresAt" > "reservedAt") AND ("expiresAt" <= ("reservedAt" + '7 days'::interval))) OR (((kind)::text = 'COMMITTED'::text) AND ("expiresAt" IS NULL))))

objects.name: InventoryExportLine_loaded_destination_check
objects.definition: CHECK ((("loadedAt" IS NULL) OR ("destinationKind" IS NOT NULL)))

objects.name: InventoryExportLine_warehouse_destination_check
objects.definition: CHECK (((("destinationKind")::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'WAREHOUSE'::text) OR ("destinationWarehouseId" IS NOT NULL)))

objects.name: InventoryPallet_spot_warehouse_check
objects.definition: CHECK ((("spotId" IS NULL) OR ("warehouseId" IS NOT NULL)))

objects.name: InventoryUnit_batch_factory_check
objects.definition: CHECK ((("batchId" IS NULL) OR ("factoryId" IS NOT NULL)))

objects.name: QuestionnaireSubmission_owner_check
objects.definition: CHECK (((("partnerId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("memberId" IS NULL)) OR (("partnerId" IS NULL) AND ("memberId" IS NOT NULL))))

objects.name: SalesForecastManualRun_check1
objects.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'READY'::text) OR ((inputs IS NOT NULL) AND (result IS NOT NULL) AND ("capturedAt" IS NOT NULL))))

objects.name: SalesForecastRun_check1
objects.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'READY'::text) OR ((inputs IS NOT NULL) AND (result IS NOT NULL) AND ("capturedAt" IS NOT NULL))))

objects.name: SalesPayment_check2
objects.definition: CHECK (((source <> 'XERO'::text) OR (("xeroInvoiceId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("receivedOn" IS NOT NULL))))

IF target_merged_into IS NOT NULL THEN

-- Retire source LAST. Prior aliases/audits can still point here; links may
-- follow an alias chain. No live or soft-deleted child rows may be stranded.
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."Deal" WHERE "clientId" = OLD."id")
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."ClientContact" WHERE "clientId" = OLD."id")
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."ClientLabelAssignment" WHERE "clientId" = OLD."id")
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."ClientEvent" WHERE "clientId" = OLD."id")
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."Client" WHERE "parentClientId" = OLD."id") THEN
RAISE EXCEPTION 'Move every client relationship before retiring the source' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
